```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(ggplot2)
library(terra)
library(tidyterra)
library(ggspatial)
library(maps)
library(geodata)
library(ENMeval)
library(ecospat)
library(patchwork)
```

## R Markdown

```{r, filtering data}
skunk.data.df<- read.csv("sp_occur_clean.csv")
skunk.data.df <- filter(skunk.data.df, country == "United States of America")
skunk.data<- vect(skunk.data.df, crs = "epsg:4326", geom = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"))



```




```{r}


chixy<-ext(-120.5,-119.4,33.6,34.2)
skonka<-erase(skunk.data, chixy)
plot(e)
#whole map
map("world", xlim=c(-125,-90), ylim=c(15,50))
points(e)
map.axes()



#cropped points
#map("world", xlim=c(-120.5,-119), ylim=c(33.6,34.8))
#points(e)
#map.axes()
```
```{r, minimum temp}
climate <- worldclim_global(var = "bio", res = 2.5, download = TRUE, path = "data")

plot(climate[[6]], xlim=c(-125,-90), ylim=c(15,50), main = "minimum temp. in coldest month")
points(skunk.data)

```
```{r}

skunk.utm <- project(skonka, "epsg:32610")


buffer.utm <- terra::buffer(skunk.utm, width = 400000)
buffer.utm <- aggregate(buffer.utm)
plot(buffer.utm)
points(skunk.utm)

buffer.wgs <- project(buffer.utm, skonka)

```



```{r, climate-vars}


subset.clim <- climate[[c(6, 12)]]
plot(subset.clim)


crop.clim <- terra::crop(subset.clim, buffer.wgs)


final.clim <- terra::mask(crop.clim, buffer.wgs)
plot(final.clim[[1]])

plot(buffer.wgs, add=TRUE)
points(skunk.data)

```



```{r}


stack <- c(r1, r2, ...)


```


tune.args <- list(fc = c("LHT"), 
                   rm = seq(from=2, to=2, by=1))

tune.args

partition.settings <- list(kfolds = 3)

max.output <- ENMevaluate(occs = crds(skonka),
                          envs = final.clim,
                          tune.args = tune.args,
                          algorithm = "maxnet",
                          partitions = "randomkfold",
                          partition.settings = partition.settings,
                          parallel = TRUE)

max.output

max.output@results

evalplot.stats(e = max.output, stats = "AICc", color.var = "fc", x.var = "rm")

max.output@results[ , c("tune.args", "AICc", "delta.AICc", "cbi.val.avg","auc.val.avg")]

results.table <- max.output@results

best.name <- results.table$tune.args[which(results.table$delta.AICc == 0)[1]]
best.name

best.model <- max.output@models[[best.name]]
plot(best.model)


current.suitability <- max.output@predictions[[names(max.output@predictions) == best.name]]
crs(current.suitability) <- crs(final.clim)

par(mfrow=c(1,1))
plot(current.suitability)
points(skunk.data)

```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r current-suit}


ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = current.suitability) +
  geom_spatvector(data = skunk.utm) +
  scale_fill_princess_c(name = "Suitability") +
  annotation_north_arrow(location = "tr") +
  annotation_scale(location = "bl") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Current Suitability")

```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
